Raw blocks

+

+ A raw block — four staches, {t("{{{{helper}}}}…{{{{/helper}}}}")} — + hands its body to the helper unprocessed: the inner + {t("{{bar}}")} is never interpreted, it's literal text the helper + receives via options.fn(). Useful when a template must emit + mustache syntax it should not expand (docs, code samples). Here + raw-loud upper-cases the raw body, so the verbatim + {t("{{bar}}")} comes out as {t("{{BAR}}")} — the + data's bar is never read. +
